description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Stunning Home!* Gulfview Heights Beach Access- 880 Yards away!* Beautiful Fenced-In Community Pool* Golf cart included with your reservation — no deposit required* Spacious Front Porch & Private Balcony* Snorkel the Seahorse Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Walk to Goatfeathers Rest., Local Catch Bar and Grill + local shops* 0.7 miles to Gulf Place: Perfect Pig, Shunk Gulley and more* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions. *Welcome to Little Bird’s Nest, a bright and inviting 4-bedroom coastal retreat perfectly situated near the heart of 30A! Just a short stroll from the beach and minutes from some of the area’s favorite restaurants, shops, and attractions, this beautifully designed home puts you close to everything while still offering a peaceful place to unwind. Spend your days at the beach, then cool off in the beautiful fenced-in community pool, surrounded by swaying palms and comfortable lounge chairs. Whether you’re relaxing poolside or enjoying time together at home, Little Bird’s Nest is the perfect setting for an unforgettable beach getaway. Step inside to a spacious, open-concept living area filled with natural light. The well-appointed chef’s kitchen offers plenty of counter space and connects seamlessly to the dining and living areas, making it easy to gather, cook, and enjoy meals together. The inviting living room features soaring ceilings and plenty of room for everyone to relax. Settle in for a family movie night or break out a board game after a day at the beach. A highchair and Pack ’n Play are also provided for families traveling with little ones. Step outside onto the spacious front porch, the perfect spot to sip your morning coffee or wind down in the evening. An outdoor shower makes rinsing off after a beach day a breeze and helps keep those sandy feet outside.The first-floor master suite is conveniently located just off the kitchen and offers a comfortable retreat with a king bed and private bathroom. Upstairs, you’ll find a fun-filled bunk area complete with a TV and access to the private balcony. It’s the perfect hangout for kids to relax, play, and enjoy their own space during your stay. A conveniently located hallway bathroom serves the bunk area, while three additional king bedrooms complete the second floor with private bathrooms in select bedrooms; everyone can enjoy a little extra space and privacy. Little Bird’s Nest is the perfect home base for your next 30A beach vacation!The Bed Setup:1st FloorMaster Bedroom 1: King Bed2nd FloorGuest Bedroom 1: King BedGuest Bedroom 2: King BedGuest Bedroom 3: King BedBunk Nook: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk BedsBeach Nest is a small community of coastal homes accented with upscale touches. Ideally located in Gulfview Heights, close to Gulf Place on the west side of Hwy 30A. Beach Nest features a lovely, gated community pool for guests to enjoy. Take a stroll to Gulfview Heights beach access or dine at some local favorites only a block or two away. Come experience the Beach Nest community and see why you’ll be returning year after year!Area Attractions: Little Bird's Nest is perfectly situated, with Grayton Beach, Seaside, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach just minutes away to the East. Located in an upscale area of Hwy 30A, this pristine house is perched between Destin and Seaside. Just a 13-minute drive to Grand Boulevard Town Center with over 35 shops and restaurants, as well as the all-new state-of-the-art Boulevard 10 Movie Theater. Bike down to Blue Mountain Creamery for a cone or meander along the miles of trails! The Gulf Place community is located along a 26-mile stretch of sugar-white sand and turquoise waters of Northwest Florida’s celebrated Emerald Coast. As one of the 16 distinct beach neighborhoods in South Walton, it has its own distinct character and charm. This colorful community on 30A comprises 25 acres located in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach on the corner of 30A and 393. Gulf Place was specifically designed to slow visitors and locals down with palm tree-lined streets, wide sidewalks, colorful outdoor patios with large umbrellas, nature walking trails, green spaces, and ample park benches to sit and enjoy the views. Gulf Place is unique among all the other South Walton neighborhoods. Residents and guests gather here to enjoy original art, boutique shopping, local cuisine, live music, and a laid-back atmosphere. 30A is a fantastic destination; the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar-white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone: kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
